**ZZ2009D** is a specific medical procedure code used within the NordEPJ electronic health record system to document the clinical assessment that there is no indication for creating a nutrition plan. 

In the context of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] (AKDB), ZZ2009D highlights a critical technical infrastructure and data registration challenge. According to regional feedback from Regionshospital Nordjylland, the clinical activity for nutrition plans ("ernæringsplan") in NordEPJ is not properly linked to procedure codes such as ZZ2009D and its counterpart [[zz2009c|ZZ2009C]] [^src1]. 

Because this linkage is missing in the electronic journal system, data regarding these nutritional assessments cannot be automatically harvested into the AKDB [^src1]. This technical limitation prevents correct data collection and supports the hospital's claims regarding registration difficulties for specific quality indicators, notably indicator 7. The issue with ZZ2009D illustrates the broader systemic challenges of implementing national quality measurements in Danish acute surgery, where technical limitations in local EPJ systems and unclear definition frameworks threaten the validity and usability of indicator results for regional and hospital-level quality development.

## Mentions
- Page 101: "Regionalt er vi blevet bekendt med, at aktiviteten ernæringsplan i NordEPJ ikke er tilknyttet følgende procedurekoder, hvorfor data ikke høstes til AKDB.

ZZ2009D Vurdering: Ingen indikation for udarbejdelse af ernæringsplan" [^src1]
